name: Google Gemini API
purpose: A cloud API that allows applications to use Google's Gemini AI models for text generation and multimodal tasks.
advantages: Free tier available for supported models
limitations: Free-tier prompts and responses may be used to improve Google products
Pricing and model availability can change
Official terms require users to be at least 18 years old

hardware.notes: The AI model runs as a cloud service. A local GPU is not required for API calls.

integration.notes: Requires API access and an API key. Keep the API key secure on the server side.

restrictions: Model availability and rate limits vary
Usage limits can depend on the project
Free-tier data-use terms differ from paid-tier terms

pricing.notes: Exact pricing depends on the model and usage. Check the official pricing page before final submission.

licence.name: Proprietary service terms; Python SDK licensed separately
licence.notes: The API service terms and the SDK software licence are separate. Confirm the current terms before finalising.

access_requirements.other: Official Gemini API terms require users to be at least 18 years old.

not_ideal_for: applications that must run without internet

verification.overall_notes: Draft entry. Confirm the current pricing, licence, usage limits, schema and age restrictions before including this entry in the final dataset.
